blocks.text: Galápagos: a seabird above boats and waterfront homes
Green islets amid turquoise lagoons and deep blue sea

## Price per person, USD

| Option | Diving days | DBL | SGL / SNGL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 days / 3 nights | 2 | $1861 | $2577 |
| 5 days / 4 nights | 3 | $2466 | $3315 |

Both programmes include accommodation at Hotel Fiesta. Breakfast and lunch are provided each day, with breakfast only on departure day. Flights, national park fees and the transit card are paid separately.

## Accommodation and preparation

On the first day, after your transfer, visit the dive centre to try on the equipment or check your own gear. On diving days, head out in the morning and return to Santa Cruz after lunch. Sites vary by day of the week and conditions.

## Weekly dive schedule

| Day | Dive sites |
|---|---|
| Monday | FLOREANA (2 dives) |
| Tuesday | GORDON (2 dives) *** |
| Wednesday | NORTH MOSQUERA / SEYMOUR CHANNEL |
| Thursday | BARTOLOME / COUSINS |
| Friday | SOUTH MOSQUERA / DAPHNE |
| Saturday | SEYMOUR NORTHEAST / SEYMOUR CHANNEL |
| Sunday | PLAZAS / GORDON*** |

See the excursion section of the itinerary for full descriptions of the 12 possible dive sites, departure times and requirements for participants. Gordon Rocks has separate experience requirements, and the dive centre confirms access. A 4- or 5-day itinerary covers only some of the sites listed.
